stories.headline: Replit makes OpenAI its default over Anthropic, CEO says
stories.summary: Replit has selected OpenAI as its default model provider, replacing Anthropic on its AI coding platform. While Anthropic's Claude model remains accessible to users, Replit CEO Amjad Masad cited internal performance benchmarks and lower costs as key reasons for making OpenAI the default option.

stories.headline: Anthropic says its workforce has become less junior and is spending more time in meetings
stories.summary: Anthropic published a report detailing how AI adoption has shifted its internal workforce composition and daily operations over the past year. The study found that its employee base has become less junior and staff are spending more time in meetings, which the company suggests could indicate how AI will alter hiring and labor demand across the broader economy.

stories.headline: TikTok permanently bans ‘Musk’ documentary advertising account
stories.summary: TikTok has permanently suspended the advertising account for an upcoming Elon Musk documentary directed by Alex Gibney. The film's distributor, Bleecker Street, was notified by the platform that the account was banned due to rules surrounding political content.

stories.headline: TikTok bans Musk documentary account
stories.summary: TikTok has permanently suspended the official account for filmmaker Alex Gibney's upcoming Elon Musk documentary just ahead of its wider release. Distributor Bleecker Street was informed of the permanent ban, though TikTok has not yet publicly commented on the reason behind the removal.

stories.headline: Starlink, Jio & OneWeb: Untangling The Satcom Queue
stories.summary: Satellite communication providers including Starlink, Reliance Jio, and Eutelsat OneWeb are navigating regulatory approvals and spectrum allocation processes to launch satellite broadband services in India. The companies are working through government licensing requirements to deploy satcom infrastructure across the country.

stories.headline: Decoding Urban Company’s ₹2,500 Cr Fundraise Proposal
stories.summary: Urban Company's board has approved a proposal to raise up to ₹2,500 crore. The Indian home services marketplace plans to use the fresh capital to strengthen its balance sheet and fund future growth initiatives.

stories.headline: Mercedes-AMG’s first ground-up SUV is a 1,150hp electric beast
stories.summary: Mercedes-AMG has unveiled details about its first ground-up electric SUV, slated for a 2028 release. The high-performance vehicle will feature three axial flux motors delivering over 1,150 horsepower alongside ultra-fast charging capabilities.

stories.headline: Software’s new consolidator gets big vote of confidence from Berkshire
stories.summary: Italian software consolidator Bending Spoons received a $330 million investment from Berkshire Hathaway, bringing Berkshire's total stake in the company to over $900 million. The Milan-based firm, which owns legacy platforms such as Vimeo, Eventbrite, and Evernote, saw its stock surge up to 41% following the announcement. The investment underscores growing market confidence in Bending Spoons' strategy of acquiring older internet brands and software startups affected by the artificial intelligence boom.
